environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) with no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached to the subnet route table. Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint has an endpoint policy restricting aws:PrincipalOrgID to o-abc123def4. The endpoint's associated security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. The NLB fronting the service operates at Layer 4 (TCP passthrough) and the TLS termination occurs at the Fargate task level using mutual TLS (mTLS) with a private CA (ACM PCA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). Client certificates must have OU=internal-services,O=AcmeCorp. There is no public DNS record; the service is only resolvable via the VPC endpoint's private DNS name (api.internal.acmecorp.io). Route table for the private subnet has no 0.0.0.0/0 route.
